Brand Introduction:
Persistence is a faith-driven clothing brand focused on discipline, hard work, and Christian values. We inspire individuals to overcome challenges and grow in strength, both physically and spiritually.

Product Description:
Our oversized T-shirts, like the limited-edition Tenacity and Destiny, are crafted for those committed to faith, resilience, and hard work. Each shirt tells a story of endurance and victory.

Payment Terms:
Affiliates earn 10% of every sale, with the opportunity to scale commissions after hitting sales targets. Commissions are paid out at the end of each month.

Other Info:
Join our affiliate program and inspire others while earning commissions on every sale.

Persistence Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions

Welcome to the Persistence Affiliate Program. By joining and participating in our program, you agree to the following terms and conditions. Please read them carefully before registering.


1. Eligibility

1.1 To participate in the Persistence Affiliate Program, you must:

  • Be at least 18 years of age.

  • Be a resident of South Africa.

1.2 By registering, you confirm that you meet these eligibility criteria.


2. Commissions

2.1 Affiliates will earn a 10% commission on the net sales value of referred purchases. 2.2 Net sales value excludes shipping costs, taxes, and any additional fees. 2.3 Commissions will only be paid for completed sales that are not canceled, refunded, or disputed.


3. Payment Information

3.1 Affiliates are responsible for providing accurate and up-to-date banking information for commission payments. 3.2 Persistence is not responsible for delayed or lost payments due to incorrect banking details provided by the affiliate.


4. Affiliate Relationship

4.1 Participation in the Persistence Affiliate Program does not establish an employment, agency, or partnership relationship between the affiliate and Persistence . 4.2 Affiliates are independent participants and are not authorized to represent, act on behalf of, or bind Persistence in any capacity.


5. Personal Discount Code

5.1 Affiliates will receive a unique discount code to share with their audience, providing a 10% discount on purchases made using the code.
5.2 Persistence reserves the right to modify or change the value of the discount code at any time without prior notice to affiliates.
5.3 Misuse of the discount code, such as unauthorized promotions, may result in termination from the program. 


6. Program Termination

6.1 Persistence reserves the right to terminate or modify the Affiliate Program or these terms and conditions at any time without prior notice. 6.2 Affiliates who violate these terms may have their participation in the program revoked without notice.


7. Limitation of Liability

7.1 Persistence is not liable for any losses, damages, or disputes arising from an affiliate’s participation in the program. 7.2 Affiliates are solely responsible for complying with applicable laws and regulations related to their participation and earnings.

8. Protection of Personal Information (POPIA Compliance)

8.1 By participating in the Persistence Affiliate Program, you acknowledge and agree to comply with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) of South Africa. 8.2 You consent to the collection, processing, and storage of your personal information as required for participation in the program. 8.3 Persistence commits to protecting your personal information and will not share or distribute your data beyond what is necessary for program administration and compliance with legal obligations.

By registering for the Persistence Affiliate Program, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to these terms and conditions.
